newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony to sell 25-inch plasma display TV.
newsitem.headline: Sony to sell 25-inch plasma display TV.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Monday that it would introduce a flat colour television set for home use using a plasma display panel in Japan on December 10.
The PZ-2500, a 25-inch colour television set, is 132 mm thick, Sony said in a statement. The model will be produced on order and will be priced at 900,000 yen, Sony said.
A plasma display panel makes images of high brightness and high contrast possible.
Sony's plasma display panel uses PALC (plasma-addressed liquid crystal) technology which was jointly developed with Tektronix Inc of the United States.

NEC Corp said earlier this month that it and one of its units planned to jointly sell 42-inch wide colour plasma display television sets from February 1997 at a price of below 1.2 million yen. NEC said it estimated sales of plasma display television sets in the initial year at 10,000 units.

Fujitsu General Corp, part of the Fujitsu Ltd group, also said earlier this month that it would begin selling in December a home-use television set with a 42-inch wide format colour plasma display panel. Fujitsu said the price would be 1.2 million yen.
